storyBible.universeName: Elysia: Aethelgard & The Tower of Sun
storyBible.storyStyle: Atmospheric, visceral, high-stakes narrative with cinematic prose, tactile magic descriptions, and morally grey character interactions.
storyBible.narratorStyle: Third-Person Limited (alternating between Valen and Lyra's perspective), sensory-heavy, grounded, and suspenseful.
storyBible.writingRules: Show, don't tell. Focus on the cold metallic gleam of silver weapons, the chemical hum of Aura Alchemy, the suffocating dampness of the Veil fog, and tension between light and shadow. Avoid modern colloquialisms.
storyBible.promptRules: Open with visceral atmospheric details or immediate physical conflict. Use realistic, sharp dialogue that reflects character worldviews. End every chapter on a high-impact narrative shift, moral dilemma, or unresolved cliffhanger.
storyBible.forbiddenRules: No easy plot resolutions, no sudden positive generic outcomes, no modern slang or flowery purple prose, never summarize dramatic confrontations that can be expressed through dialogue and action.
storyBible.customInstructions: Incorporate sensory cues of Aura Alchemy (humming silver blades, ozone smells, glowing vein patterns) and the unnatural eerie silence of the Mistwalkers.

worldLore.setting: Kingdom of Aethelgard, a dark medieval world surrounded by a wall of perpetual deadly fog known as The Veil.
worldLore.faith: The Sun Core worship—a colossal radiant gem at the peak of the Capital Tower believed to be the sole light source holding back the Mistwalkers.
worldLore.magicSystem: Aura Alchemy—channeling vital life energy through weapons forged from or plated with pure silver.
worldLore.threats: The Mistwalkers—monstrous abyssal creatures lurking within the Veil, repelled only by Sun Core energy and silver-channeled alchemy.

characters.name: Sir Valen Vance
characters.occupation: Elite Silver Knight of the Sun Guard
characters.personality: Rigid, dutiful, stoic, deeply haunted by guilt over his younger sister's death.
characters.relationships: Divergent ally to Lyra Thorne; loyal subject (initially) to Lord Regent Julian; brother to Eliana (believed dead).
characters.biography: Decorated captain of Aethelgard's elite order. Has devoted his life to defending the realm, believing his sister died honorably in battle at the Veil border.
characters.location: Capital Citadel / Tower of Sun Sub-Crypts
characters.notes: Wields an ancestral longsword with pure-silver inlay; skilled in Aura Alchemy force-projection.

characters.name: Lyra Thorne
characters.personality: Cynical, pragmatic, sharp-tongued, fiercely independent, perceptive.
characters.relationships: Reluctant ally to Valen Vance; sworn enemy of the Royal Inquisition.
characters.biography: Raised in the lower slums beneath the shadow of the Tower. Possesses a rare natural gift to visually perceive the flow and resonance of magical aura streams.
characters.location: Capital Citadel / Tower of Sun Sub-Crypts
characters.notes: Carries dual silver-plated daggers; capable of seeing magic leylines and structural weakness in alchemy constructs.

characters.name: Lord Regent Julian
characters.occupation: Shadow Ruler of Aethelgard & High Custodian
characters.personality: Charismatic, ruthless, pious on the surface, coldly utilitarian.
characters.relationships: Commander of Valen Vance; prosecutor of Lyra Thorne.
characters.biography: Maintains the illusion of holy order while secretly managing the gruesome soul-harvesting machinery that powers the Sun Core to sustain his own reign and power.
characters.notes: Master manipulator of both political factions and forbidden necrotic alchemy.

episodes.title: The Silver Vow
episodes.summary: Valen Vance corners the elusive street thief Lyra Thorne inside the sacred sub-crypts of the Tower of Sun as she attempts to extract a shard of the Sun Core. Upon capture, Lyra insists she is not stealing but trying to disrupt an ongoing slaughter. When Valen touches the core shard held by Lyra, his silver-bound aura resonates with her vision—revealing that the Sun Core is a soul-harvesting engine, and that his missing sister was sacrificed into its core.
